title: The formation of Gd4O4 cubane cluster controlled by L-valine

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetranuclear gadolinium(III) cubane cluster with L-valine

synthesis.procedure: Gd(ClO4)3 (2.0 mmol) and L-valine (Hval) (1 mmol) were mixed in water (ca. 15 ml). The mixed solution was carefully adjusted to pH 6.3 with 0.5 M aqueous NaOH under heating and stirring for ca. 1 h until a precipitate formed due to hydrolyzation of Gd3+. The mixture was then filtered and the filtrate was evaporated slowly at room temperature, yielding colorless prismatic crystals in 10 days (42% yield based on valine). The crystals easily lose water in air.
synthesis.temperature: heating during pH adjustment; crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.time: ca. 1 h heating/stirring; crystals in 10 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aqueous hydrolysis under heating and stirring, then filtration
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate evaporated slowly at room temperature to give colorless prismatic crystals
